Sistema de Información Cultural, Secretaría de Cultura, Catedral Metropolitana
facts: The current spires are nineteenth-century replacements and approximately 65 metres high.
The basilican interior has three naves and side chapels associated with the towers.
Manuel Gómez Ibarra finished the pointed replacement towers in 1854. The dome illuminating the east end was completed by Domingo Torres in 1875.
